name: The Fairmont Royal Pavilion
positioning: Beachfront hotel on Barbados' Platinum Coast, where all guestrooms and suites are directly on the beach (official name Fairmont Royal Pavilion)
best_for: Couples and honeymooners wanting a beachfront stay
Travelers who like gardens, afternoon tea and dinner on the sand

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Fairmont Royal Pavilion, Holetown, Barbados

facts.text: The hotel is a luxury beachfront hotel on Barbados' Platinum Coast.
All guestrooms and suites are located directly on the beach, with ocean views.
The hotel was formerly The Miramar Hotel, built in the 1940s, and was the first hotel built on the west coast of Barbados.
The gardens were originally designed by South American landscape architect Fernando Tabora.
The hotel offers botanical garden tours every Wednesday at 10am.
Restaurants include Palm Terrace and Taboras.
Afternoon tea is served at the beachfront restaurant with ocean views.
Guests can have dinner directly on the beach.
A three-bedroom villa sits in the gardens.
Spa treatments are brought to guests in their own oceanfront room or suite.
Watersports include paddleboarding, kayaking and snorkeling with turtles.
The hotel has an outdoor freshwater swimming pool and a heated jacuzzi.
